entities.summary: Bernardo Dovizi of Bibbiena was an Italian cardinal and comedy writer, known best as Cardinal Bibbiena, for the town of Bibbiena, where he was born. He was created cardinal by Pope Clement VII in 1527, and became a prominent figure in the Catholic Church during the Renaissance. Dovizi served as the cardinal-priest of San Pietro in Vincoli from 1527 to 1539. He was also a prolific writer, producing numerous comedies and poems, including the famous comedy 'Il Ducale'. Dovizi's work was heavily influenced by the humanist movement, which emphasized the importance of classical learning and individualism. His legacy as a writer and theologian has endured, with many of his works still studied and performed today. "The world is a stage, and all the men and women merely players" - Bernardo Dovizi, Il Ducale.
